description: This PHP source file is a web-based user interface for MTA (Media Transfer Adapter) Line Diagnostics in a network gateway device. It includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP code to initiate and display diagnostics tests for two telephony lines, handle user interactions, and dynamically update test statuses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the page context and navigation highlighting.

methods.name: click handlers for #start_diagnostics1 and #start_diagnostics2
methods.description: Handle user clicks to start diagnostics for line 1 and line 2, performing AJAX requests to retrieve and update status.
